title: Validated unknown ASCII appData string raw-emission route
mode: local fast implementation slice with generated in-memory controls
scope: Reconcile writeAppData validation of unknown ASCII string groups with its emitted-byte sink
Add a focused code-482 output/sentinel control without adding a persistent drawing fixture

implementation.summary: writeAppData now routes only a validated unknown string code in ASCII (DxfValueKind::Unknown && !binFile) through writeRawString after the existing opaque-text preflight. Assigned strings, handles, binary chunks, and typed numeric/Boolean variants retain their existing sinks; Binary unknown string groups remain rejected during whole-group validation before output.
implementation.wireBehaviorDetail: This makes an already-admitted, prevalidated unknown ASCII appData string spelling emit successfully; it does not alter recognized code encodings or Binary behavior.

generatedControls.ascii: An in-memory balanced appData group containing unknown group code 482 emits its exact source spelling and a following group-0 WIRE_END sentinel.
generatedControls.binary: The same unknown string group is refused before any bytes are emitted.

validation.reasonCompatibilityCompileOmitted: No public header or callback contract changed.

assessment.localMismatchFound: The writeAppData complete-group validator accepted unknown string codes for ASCII, but the emission branch sent them to typed writeString, which rejects unknown codes.
assessment.claim: The already-authorized ASCII appData unknown-string branch now emits through the explicit raw sink after prevalidation. The same value remains refused for Binary before output.
assessment.coverage: Generated code-482 controls verify exact ASCII spelling, a following record sentinel, and Binary pre-emission refusal.
assessment.limitations: This closes only the validated unknown-string appData emission branch. It does not complete the full dynamic writer-family inventory, support arbitrary unknown codes in other APIs, establish a producer/profile contract for other ranges, or qualify native/peer acceptance.
